source.observedTitle: iPhone 15 Plus Face ID | Nice Try! | Apple Malaysia Advertisement
source.method: Manual browser player screenshots at 0,3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,27 seconds, plus exported auto captions.
source.limits: Third-party repost. Sampled visual inspection; exact cut boundaries, lens values and full audio have not been measured. No paid analyzer. No performance inference from views.

captions.ignored: The 28-second fragment is an unreliable automatic transcription; it is not used as dialogue.

adaptation.borrow: Character intent, prop insert, attempt, reaction coverage, escalation, owner payoff, product held in scene.
adaptation.change: Two adult gray proxies at a contemporary cafe/table; fingerprint attempt and registered-owner touch instead of Apple's Face ID story. Original shot timings and camera motion.
adaptation.claimBoundary: Vivo X80 supports in-display fingerprint scanning. This is an illustrative storyboard, not measured authentication latency or spoof resistance. Do not claim TrueDepth or Face ID equivalence.

product.name: vivo X80, standard global glass model
product.layoutObservation: Official render: rectangular Cloud Window upper back, large circular camera area to its left; large primary lens upper-left within circle, two smaller lenses lower-left and lower-right, flash outside circle at rectangle right; centered front punch-hole. Proxy details approximate.
product.finishBoundary: Clay model supplies scale, silhouette and blocking only. Real phone appearance must come from a separate product reference in a later approved AI test.
